site_title: 자와 각도기의 방 — 시아·모아의 유클리드 공간

items.prompt_en: Bright daytime research lab corridor, clean white walls, ten numbered doors (1–10), each engraved with a geometry symbol (ruler, protractor, right-angle mark, circle, dashed projection line). Two young female interns in maid-style lab outfits — black hair with a transparent ruler, beige hair with a protractor and notebook — in front of door 1. Cute anime style, teal/orange/navy accents, white background, empty space on the right for title. 16:9.

White lab corridor entrance, a doctor in a lab coat with glasses opening two backpacks on a white table; graph paper, a ruler and a protractor come out. Black-haired intern smiling, beige-haired intern curious. White background, 16:9.

White lab room with a large floor grid, two glowing points joined by a teal straight line and dashed right-triangle legs (3 and 4), soft orange angle arc; black-haired intern points, beige-haired intern measures with a ruler. Minimal, white background, 16:9.

White lab room, an orange arrow casting a sharp shadow straight down onto a translucent teal plane, a thin dividing panel splitting blue dots into two groups; beige-haired intern proud, black-haired intern sheepish. Minimal, white background, 16:9.
